definitions.gold_depth: Maximum of the two raw undirected GraphML shortest-path distances.
definitions.gold_structure: CONSUMES forward, then IMPLEMENTS against its raw arrow.
definitions.degree: Raw undirected multigraph degree. Unique-neighbor counts are separate.
definitions.seed_median: Median of the six per-seed hit counts where the seed study exists.
definitions.nearest: Raw undirected shortest distance from missing gold. Ties use earliest discovery rank.
definitions.frontier_or_pruned: Eligible start neighbors are candidates in round one. A gold with no allowed move from any returned node was beyond the returned frontier. Later candidate selection cannot be recovered without a beam trace.
definitions.within_two_hops: Includes the start at distance zero.
